decisive_finding.issue: Compatibility deadlines and version boundaries are structurally present but are not enforced against trusted current time or current product version before authorization or effect execution.
evidence: The model validates a deadline only relative to the usage-measurement window.
The registry has no trusted current-time or current-version input.
The runtime validates authorization lifetime but never the compatibility boundary.
An isolated route with measurement_end=2000, deadline=2500, and trusted current time 3000 still derived, authorized, and applied one confined effect.
decisive_finding.impact: An already expired or version-crossed compatibility route can be newly adopted and executed, defeating its enforceable retirement boundary.
decisive_finding.required_fix: Bind a trusted current-time or current-version observation into planning, sealed authorization, durable journal, and pre-effect revalidation; refuse already-crossed and post-authorization-crossed boundaries with zero new effect.

review_limits: Review stopped at the first material defect. Remaining durability, recovery, concurrency, rollback, and full focused closure were not independently cleared.
claim_ceiling: REWORK; no source-local acceptance or higher claim.
no_claim_statement: No claim of integration, public migration behavior, actual route retirement, installation, runtime behavior, readiness, release, node closure, or completion.
